name: Varigated Yellow Pond-Lily
desc: Varigated Yellow Pond-Lily (Nuphar variegata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Nuphar variegata is rhizomatous, perennial, aquatic herb in the water lily family Nymphaeaceae native to much of Canada and the northernmost of the United States.
